Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Cramped
Hirelings: 1
Order: Empower

A solemn chamber where you make offerings to mysterious forces.

Empower: Purge Haunted Facility. The hireling leads a 7-day ritual during which you must stay in the Bastion. At its end, you offer a worthy sacrifice: 1,000 GP, or blood (the fresh corpse of at least one Large creature or four Medium creatures that aren't Constructs or Undead). If you offer blood, roll on the Bastion Hauntings table. The sacrifice is destroyed, and a Haunted special facility of your choice in this Bastion or a Bastion connected to it is no longer Haunted.

Blasphemous Charm. After you spend a Long Rest in your Ancient Altar, you gain a magical Charm that lasts for 7 days or until you use it: as a Magic action, you can use it to cast Hunger of Hadar without Material components. You can't gain this Charm again while you have it.

Source: Ravenloft: The Horrors Within.
